snippet.title: One Turkey, Two Turkeys - TIC-80 Gameplay
snippet.description:
A game about counting turkeys. Inspired by the Rifftrax riff of "One Turkey, Two Turkeys".

Developed by Neale Pickett
Game page: https://tic80.com/play?cart=1046

#theforeseenarcade #tic80 #retrogaming #retrogames #tic80games #fantasyconsole #rifftrax #oneturkeytwoturkeys #turkeys #acifilms #aci

At least the turkeys won't have to deal with kazoos in this one.
